title: Skyworth SWTV-24AE-4K NF (device eleonas, product SW10_NA_NF, MediaTek mt5896), South Africa/Global
header:
Skyworth SWTV-24AE-4K NF (device eleonas, product SW10_NA_NF, MediaTek mt5896), South Africa/Global
Google TV 14 (API 34), build UKN6.260116.056, security patch 2026-04-01. ~1 GB RAM, armeabi-v7a.
ro.product.model="SWTV-24AE-4K NF". Same eleonas platform as examples/skyworth-swtv-24na-4k-nf;
the NA variant reports ro.product.vendor.model=SWTV-24AE-4K, confirming the shared board.

Apply:   $env:TV_HOST="<tv ip>"; tools\disable.ps1 examples\skyworth-swtv-24ae-4k-nf\debloat.txt
Undo:    $env:TV_HOST="<tv ip>"; tools\restore.ps1 examples\skyworth-swtv-24ae-4k-nf\debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Re-enable any line with `pm enable --user 0 <package>`.

Applied 2026-10-21 in batches with a screenshot after each, then custom launcher installed.
Home, Inputs (HDMI 1/2/3/Composite), Settings and the app grid all verified on the day.

Disabled from the factory on this unit, so NOT listed here (restore.sh would turn them ON):
com.cltv.hybrid, com.cltv.mal (iWedia CanaliTV Live TV - no tuner in use on this unit)
com.app.mlounge, com.mediatek.tv.retaildemo, com.mediatek.opapp
com.mediatek.dtv.tvinput.atsctuner, com.mediatek.dtv.tvinput.isdbtuner

Quirks on this firmware, all verified on the TV:
- Only Wireless debugging: port 5555 stays closed. Pair once with the stock adb:
adb pair 192.168.1.122:<pairing port> <code>
adb connect 192.168.1.122:<connect port>
adb -s 192.168.1.122:<connect port> tcpip 5555
Port 5555 closes on every reboot; repeat `adb connect` + `adb tcpip 5555` each session.
- Android switches Wireless debugging off on every reboot; turn it back on in Developer options.
- All Wi-Fi networks owned by android.uid.system (not setupwraith) on this unit - safe to disable.
- Chromecast (mediashell) verified NOT using setupwraith's CastInfoProvider on this build;
disabling setupwraith does not break casting.
- All disables survived a full reboot (firmware does not auto-re-enable on this build).
- Display: 3840x2160 physical, 1920x1080 override (normal for this SoC), density 320, no forced override.

Stock launcher:   com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Setup wizard:     com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith (RecoveryActivity claims HOME at priority 1)
HDMI/AV inputs:   com.mediatek.tis
Live TV / tuner:  com.cltv.hybrid (iWedia CanaliTV) — already disabled from factory on this unit
Remote service:   com.smartdevice.global.service (BLE, battery, find-my-remote, hot keys)

Kept on purpose: com.mediatek.tis (HDMI/AV input driver), com.mediatek.tv.agent (hot keys, Netflix key),
com.mediatek.autopair (remote pairing), com.smartdevice.global.service (BLE remote),
com.smartdevice.dailyshortcut (quick menu), com.smartdevice.duplebluetooth, com.smartdevice.factory,
org.liskovsoft.androidtv.rukeyboard + com.google.android.inputmethod.latin (keyboards),
com.google.android.apps.mediashell (Chromecast), com.google.android.katniss (Assistant),
com.google.android.apps.tv.dreamx (screensaver), Play Store, Play Services.
Kept by owner's choice: com.netflix.ninja, com.google.android.youtube.tv, com.crunchyroll.crunchyroid,
com.spotify.tv.android, com.streamflixreborn.streamflix, com.sportzx.live, com.internet.tvbrowser.

apps.note: records first activation; boot + network receivers
Coocaa recommendation rows; bundles Sensors Data analytics
partner config that injects rows into the home screen

sections.title: Regional broadcast extras (neither used in ZA/Global market)
Streaming apps disabled by owner's choice (not used)
Stock home — disabled LAST, after the new launcher is installed and verified as Home
sections.note: WARNING: check `dumpsys wifi | grep -o 'cname=[^ ]*'` first — if it names setupwraith, forget the network and re-join it in Settings before disabling setupwraith (on THIS unit it was android.uid.system).
